subject: app_config keys + pydantic schemas + AppConfigService read API (models/budget/search/generation, flags, nav, exam_rules, ui_copy)
body:
# `app_config` keys, pydantic schemas and the read API (S05 -> S04, S03, later segments)

Owner: seg05-seed. Code: `apps/api/naadi_api/config_api/` (`schemas.py`, `service.py`, `routes.py`). Seed sources: `config/models.yaml` (models, budget, search, generation), `config/sources.yaml` header (sources_policy), and a new `config/app_config.yaml` (feature_flags, ui.nav, exam_rules, storage, ui_copy).

## Keys (value is jsonb; every key has one pydantic model, validated on seed and on admin PUT)
| key | pydantic model | value |
|---|---|---|
| `models` | `ModelsKey {providers: dict[ProviderName, ProviderConfig], roles: dict[str, RoleConfig]}` | `providers:` + `roles:` of models.yaml, verbatim. ProviderConfig / RoleConfig / ChainEntry are the existing classes in `naadi_api/config.py` (extra="allow"), so llm.py sees exactly the YAML shape. Validation also enforces: every chain provider is under `providers`, and every openrouter model id ends in `:free` or is `openrouter/free` |
| `budget` | `config.BudgetConfig` | models.yaml `budget:` verbatim |
| `search` | `config.SearchConfig` | models.yaml `search:` verbatim |
| `generation` | `GenerationConfig` (new; extra="allow": provider, space_id, image{model,max_per_user_per_day}, video{model,max_seconds,max_per_user_per_day}, label, publish_requires_admin_approval) | models.yaml `generation:` verbatim |
| `sources_policy` | `SourcesPolicy` | publishing gates from sources.yaml (block_without_license, block_noncommercial_on_paid, block_share_alike_in_proprietary, block_non_ai_ingest_from_rag, youtube_metadata_max_age_days=30) |
| `feature_flags` | `dict[str, FeatureFlag{enabled: bool, audience: "everyone"\|"admins" = "everyone", everyone_outside_prod: bool = false}]` | today, courses, qbank, planner, notes, pathway, assistant (off until S14), search, ink_lab (enabled, audience admins, everyone_outside_prod true = today's S03 rule) |
| `ui.nav` | `list[NavItem{id,label,path,icon,feature}]` | S03's NavItem shape; only existing routes (Today; Learn gated by `courses`, which S06 flips on in config/app_config.yaml) |
| `exam_rules` | `ExamRules` | block sizes and per-mode timing/visibility (tutor / timed / exam) per exam, diagnostic block size |
| `storage` | `StorageBuckets {content_public, content_private, user_uploads, vault, generated_media}` | bucket names from 0002 |
| `ui_copy` | `dict[str, str]` (keys `^[a-z0-9_.]+$`, values <= 500 chars, `{placeholders}`) | e.g. `assistant.quota_reset` = "AI quota resets at {time} UTC" (S04: use this for BudgetExhausted) |

## Read API (Python, for llm.py / search.py / auth_routes.py)
```python
from naadi_api.config_api.service import get_app_config   # dependency / app.state.app_config
cfg = request.app.state.app_config            # AppConfigService, one per process
await cfg.get("budget")                       # -> validated pydantic model for that key
await cfg.models_config()                     # -> naadi_api.config.ModelsConfig (models + budget + search merged), the same type load_models_config() returns today
await cfg.feature_enabled("assistant", is_admin=False, app_env="prod")
```
- Cache 60 s per process; invalidated on admin PUT and, across both uvicorn workers, by a `pg_notify('naadi_app_config', key)` trigger (LISTEN connection per process; TTL still bounds staleness if it drops).
- If the DB is down or a key is missing, it falls back to the YAML in `NAADI_CONFIG_DIR` (logged `app_config_fallback`, key + reason only), so llm.py never hardcodes a model or a budget.
- Seeding never overwrites a value an admin edited (`updated_by is not null`) unless `--force-config`; the report lists those keys as `kept_admin_edit`.

## HTTP
- `GET /api/config/public` (no auth, `cache-control: public, max-age=60`): feature flags resolved for anonymous / everyone, `ui.nav`, `exam_rules`, `ui_copy`. Never models, budget, search, generation or storage.
- Admin: `GET /api/admin/config` (keys + updated_at/by), `GET/PUT /api/admin/config/{key}` (PUT body `{value, expected_updated_at}`, 409 on a stale write, 422 with field errors), `GET /api/admin/config/{key}/history`.

seg04-agents: please `decision` (accept / amend), especially whether `models` should stay providers+roles verbatim. seg03-auth: FYI, once this lands /api/nav and the feature flags in /api/me and /api/public-config can read `ui.nav` / `feature_flags` through `cfg`; I will not edit auth_routes.py myself unless you hand it over.
